flow.title: Flow path
flow.description: Suction and discharge flow paths with direction arrows.

pressure.title: Stage-by-stage pressure
pressure.description: Each bowl stage (impeller + diffuser bowl) adds about the same head; the stages are stacked so pressure rises from the bell (blue) to the top bowl (red). The column and discharge head then lose a little head to friction before the discharge flange.

annotations.text: Bell inlet: lowest pressure (submergence sets NPSHa)
Column & head: 3 stage heads − column/head losses

thrust.title: Axial thrust path
thrust.description: In a vertical turbine pump the hydraulic thrust of every impeller acts downward and adds to the weight of the rotating element. The line shaft hangs from the motor: the total down-thrust is carried by the motor thrust bearing (green reaction). Impeller axial position (lift) is set at the adjusting nut / spacer coupling.

annotations.text: Total down-thrust + rotor weight → motor thrust bearing

installation.title: Sump levels & submergence
installation.description: Water levels and the submergence S above the bell inlet. ANSI/HI 9.8 gives the minimum submergence as a function of the bell diameter D and inlet velocity (S = D(1 + 2.3·F_D), F_D = V/√(gD); verify in the current edition). Low submergence causes air-entraining vortices, vibration and loss of performance. Levels shown are illustrative.

annotations.text: Floor clearance ≈ 0.3–0.5 D below the bell (ANSI/HI 9.8, verify)

summary: A vertical turbine pump is a vertically suspended, multistage centrifugal pump. The bowl assembly (impellers and diffuser bowls) is submerged at the bottom of a well or sump; a line shaft running inside the column pipe transmits torque from a vertical motor mounted on the discharge head at ground level. Each stage adds head; liquid rises through the column and leaves through the discharge head nozzle.

discharge_head.function: Supports the motor and the full suspended pump weight, turns the flow 90° from the column into the discharge nozzle and houses the shaft seal.
discharge_head.construction: Cast or fabricated body with base (sole) plate, discharge elbow and flanged nozzle, motor stand with access windows for the coupling and seal, and a register fit for the motor.
discharge_head.material: Cast iron or ductile iron for water service; fabricated carbon steel or stainless steel for higher pressure or corrosive service.
discharge_head.operating_conditions: Carries discharge pressure, nozzle loads from piping and the axial/radial reaction of the pump; must be rigid enough to keep the structural natural frequency away from running speed.
failure_modes: Cracking from excessive nozzle loads or piping misalignment
Soft-foot or grout failure at base
inspection: Check base-plate levelness and anchor-bolt torque
Verify piping is supported independently (no strain on nozzle)
Vibration measurement at motor top in two directions
Visual check for cracks and coating damage

seal_housing.function: Provides the seal chamber where the shaft leaves the pressurised head; locates the mechanical seal.
seal_housing.construction: Machined housing bolted to the head with a register fit concentric with the shaft; may include flush, vent and drain connections.
seal_housing.material: Cast iron, ductile iron or stainless steel.
seal_housing.operating_conditions: Exposed to pump discharge pressure at the head (minus column losses).
failure_modes: Air trapped in chamber leading to dry-running
inspection: Check face and bore run-out relative to the shaft

mechanical_seal.function: Prevents pumped liquid escaping along the rotating shaft at the discharge head.
mechanical_seal.construction: Cartridge seal: rotating face driven by the sleeve and spring assembly runs against a stationary seat held in the gland; secondary O-rings seal the sleeve and gland. Set collar locks the cartridge to the shaft.
mechanical_seal.material: Faces commonly carbon-graphite vs silicon carbide (or SiC vs SiC for abrasive water); stainless steel metal parts; elastomers selected for fluid and temperature.
mechanical_seal.operating_conditions: Faces need a liquid film; chamber must be vented and flooded. Seal selection and piping plans per manufacturer and, for process service, API 682.
failure_modes: Dry running at start-up (chamber not vented)
Elastomer chemical attack or compression set
Leakage from incorrect setting of the cartridge after impeller lift adjustment
inspection: Monitor leakage rate and seal temperature
Confirm setting clips removed after installation
Check flush flow if a flush is fitted

head_shaft.function: Connects the top of the line shaft to the motor through the coupling; passes through the seal.
head_shaft.construction: Precision-ground shaft with threaded lower end for the line-shaft coupling and keyed upper end for the coupling hub.
head_shaft.material: Carbon steel or stainless steel (e.g. 416, 410, 316 depending on fluid).
head_shaft.operating_conditions: Transmits full motor torque and the hydraulic down-thrust to the motor thrust bearing.
failure_modes: Bent shaft causing seal leakage and vibration
inspection: Total indicated run-out at seal area

coupling.function: Transmits torque from motor to pump and allows the impeller axial position (lift) to be set with the adjusting nut.
coupling.construction: Pump hub, adjusting nut and spacer bolted to the motor hub; spacer allows seal removal without lifting the motor.
coupling.material: Carbon steel or alloy steel; bolts per manufacturer grade.
coupling.operating_conditions: Carries torque and the full down-thrust into the motor thrust bearing.
failure_modes: Incorrect impeller lift leading to rubbing or loss of performance
Misalignment between motor and pump shafts
inspection: Verify impeller lift setting per manufacturer data

motor_frame.function: Encloses and supports the stator, bearings and terminal box; the base flange locates the motor on the discharge head.
motor_frame.construction: Cast iron or fabricated frame with cooling fins, lower and upper end shields (bearing brackets), lifting lugs, terminal box and nameplate.
motor_frame.operating_conditions: Enclosure type (e.g. WP-I, TEFC) and insulation class per motor data sheet.
failure_modes: Reed-frequency resonance of motor on head
inspection: Terminal box seal and cable gland condition

drip_cover.function: Protects the top bearing housing and the motor opening from rain and falling objects; covers the coupling access on hollow-shaft designs.
drip_cover.construction: Formed steel or cast canopy bolted to the top end shield.

stator.function: Produces the rotating magnetic field that drives the rotor.
stator.construction: Stack of insulated electrical-steel laminations with copper windings in slots; end turns project above and below the core.
stator.material: Silicon electrical steel; copper magnet wire with Class F/H insulation (typical).
stator.operating_conditions: Rated voltage/frequency; temperature rise within the insulation class.
failure_modes: Insulation breakdown from overheating or moisture

rotor.function: Squirrel-cage rotor that converts the stator field into shaft torque.
rotor.construction: Laminated core on the motor shaft with aluminium or copper bars short-circuited by end rings.
rotor.material: Electrical steel; die-cast aluminium or fabricated copper cage.
rotor.operating_conditions: Runs at slightly below synchronous speed (slip).
inspection: Vibration spectrum at 1× and pole-pass frequency

motor_shaft.function: Carries the rotor and transmits torque to the pump; on solid-shaft motors it extends below the motor into the coupling.
motor_shaft.construction: Forged/ground steel shaft with keyway at the coupling end.
motor_shaft.operating_conditions: Carries rotor weight plus pump thrust to the thrust bearing.

motor_fan.function: Moves cooling air through the motor.
motor_fan.construction: Cast or fabricated fan keyed to the motor shaft.
motor_fan.operating_conditions: Rotates with the shaft; airflow depends on direction for unidirectional fans.
inspection: Visual check for damage and dirt build-up

thrust_bearing.function: Carries the total down-thrust: hydraulic thrust from all impellers plus the weight of the rotating element (shafts, impellers, rotor).
thrust_bearing.construction: Angular-contact ball bearings (often a matched pair) or spherical roller thrust bearing in the motor upper bracket, oil or grease lubricated.
thrust_bearing.material: Bearing steel rolling elements and races.
thrust_bearing.operating_conditions: Thrust rating must cover maximum down-thrust (including at shut-off) and any momentary up-thrust at start-up.
failure_modes: Brinelling from reverse rotation or transport
inspection: Oil level/quality or regreasing per schedule

motor_guide_bearing.function: Locates the lower end of the motor shaft radially.
motor_guide_bearing.construction: Deep-groove ball bearing in the lower bracket.

column_pipe.function: Carries the pumped liquid from the bowl assembly to the discharge head and suspends the bowl assembly.
column_pipe.construction: Flanged or threaded pipe sections, typically 1.5–3 m (5–10 ft) long, with bearing retainers at the joints.
column_pipe.material: Carbon steel, galvanised steel or stainless steel.
column_pipe.operating_conditions: Internal pressure equal to discharge pressure at that elevation; tensile load from suspended weight.
failure_modes: Misalignment of sections causing bearing wear

gasket.construction: Flat ring gasket or O-ring in a groove.
gasket.material: Elastomer or compressed fibre suited to the fluid.

bearing_retainer.function: Holds the line-shaft bearing concentric with the column at each joint.
bearing_retainer.construction: Rim clamped between column flanges with radial ribs (spider) supporting a central hub.
bearing_retainer.material: Bronze, cast iron or stainless steel.
bearing_retainer.operating_conditions: Flow passes between the ribs; adds a small pressure loss.
inspection: Hub bore diameter and concentricity at overhaul

lineshaft_bearing.function: Supports the line shaft radially and limits whip between the head and the bowls.
lineshaft_bearing.construction: Fluted rubber-lined or bronze sleeve bearing, lubricated by the pumped water (open line shaft). Enclosed-shaft designs use oil-lubricated bronze bearings inside an enclosing tube.
lineshaft_bearing.material: Nitrile/neoprene rubber, bronze, or engineered polymers.
lineshaft_bearing.operating_conditions: Rubber bearings must be pre-lubricated before start if the column is dry (deep static levels).
inspection: Bore diameter / clearance check at overhaul

line_shaft.function: Transmits torque from the head shaft to the bowl shaft along the column.
line_shaft.construction: Sections matching the column length, joined by threaded couplings; ground at bearing journals.
line_shaft.material: Carbon steel, 416 or 316 stainless steel; sometimes with stainless sleeves at journals.
line_shaft.operating_conditions: Combined torsion and tension; elongates under hydraulic thrust, which must be allowed for when setting impeller lift.

bowl_shaft.function: Carries the impellers and transmits torque from the line shaft to them.
bowl_shaft.construction: Ground shaft through all bowls; impellers fixed by taper collets or keys and split rings.
bowl_shaft.material: Stainless steel (410/416/316) or duplex for corrosive service.
bowl_shaft.operating_conditions: Full torque at top stage; supported by bowl and bell bearings.
inspection: Straightness and journal diameter at overhaul

shaft_couplings.construction: Threaded sleeve coupling; threads are cut so that normal rotation tightens them.
shaft_couplings.operating_conditions: Reverse rotation (backspin after shutdown) can unscrew them; non-reverse ratchets or check valves are used where backspin is expected.
inspection: Butt the shaft ends correctly at assembly

discharge_case.function: Top bowl: collects flow from the last stage diffuser and transitions it into the column; houses the top bowl bearing.
discharge_case.construction: Casting with straightening ribs, bearing hub and flanges for the column and the top bowl.
discharge_case.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, bronze or stainless steel.
discharge_case.operating_conditions: Full discharge pressure at the bowl level.
inspection: Bore and bearing wear at overhaul

bowl_bearing.function: Radial support of the bowl shaft at each bowl, discharge case and suction bell.
bowl_bearing.construction: Sleeve bushing press-fitted in the bowl hub; product lubricated.
bowl_bearing.material: Bronze, rubber, carbon or engineered polymers; harder materials for sandy water.
bowl_bearing.operating_conditions: Lubricated by pumped liquid; the bell bearing may be grease-packed with a sand collar.

bowl.function: Diffuser casing for one stage: converts the swirl (velocity) leaving the impeller into pressure and guides flow to the next impeller eye.
bowl.construction: Casting with integral diffuser vanes, central bearing hub and bolted flanges; bowls are often enamel- or glass-lined to improve efficiency in water service.
bowl.material: Cast iron (often enamel-lined), ductile iron, bronze, stainless or duplex stainless steel.
bowl.operating_conditions: Pressure rises stage by stage; lowest bowl must have adequate submergence and NPSH margin.

wear_ring.function: Renewable close-clearance ring that limits leakage from the impeller discharge back to its eye.
wear_ring.construction: Press-fit ring in the bowl around the impeller skirt (impeller rings may also be fitted).
wear_ring.material: Bronze, stainless steel or hardened materials for abrasive service.
wear_ring.operating_conditions: Running clearance per manufacturer; leakage rises as clearance increases, reducing efficiency.
inspection: Measure diametral clearance at overhaul and compare with manufacturer limit

impeller.function: Adds energy to the liquid: rotating blades increase angular momentum (velocity and pressure).
impeller.construction: Enclosed mixed-flow impeller (hub, blades and front shroud) cast as one piece; fixed to the shaft by a taper collet. Semi-open impellers are also used and are set with a smaller axial clearance.
impeller.material: Bronze, cast iron, stainless steel or duplex.
impeller.operating_conditions: Rotates at motor speed; produces both head and axial down-thrust.
failure_modes: Cavitation erosion at blade inlet (low submergence/NPSH)

collet.function: Locks the impeller on the shaft by friction.
collet.construction: Split tapered sleeve driven into the impeller hub bore.
collet.operating_conditions: Must resist torque and thrust; removed with a collet driver at overhaul.

suction_bell.function: Guides liquid smoothly into the first-stage impeller and holds the bottom shaft bearing.
suction_bell.construction: Bell-mouth casting with ribs and bearing hub; often fitted with a strainer.
suction_bell.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, bronze or stainless steel.
suction_bell.operating_conditions: Submergence above the bell lip must meet intake design guidance to avoid vortices and air entrainment.
inspection: Check bell and ribs for erosion
Verify water level versus minimum submergence

strainer.function: Keeps large debris out of the pump.
strainer.construction: Clip-on cone or basket strainer of bars or perforated plate; open area normally several times the bell area.
strainer.operating_conditions: Clogging raises inlet losses and reduces NPSH available.
